positions.name: MissingIdGracefulDegradation
positions.frame: what must the derive-id pipeline guarantee when it encounters a heading without an id field?
positions.why: src-1 identifies the failure pattern being reproduced — a ## level heading with no id field from production — while src-2 states the behavioral contract the pipeline must satisfy in that scenario: no crash and a valid slug. Both expressions cohere under the question of what guarantees the derive-id path must hold when the id field is absent.
